did: A cards essay's episode page now has the place for its YouTube link that you asked for: paste it there and home keeps it with the essay, as it does for the call and the Rust essay. The essay's own page, opened from Renders, points to that episode page. My data still offers no way to let a cards essay go, so home keeps every one. Until home runs the release with its half, a paste says to update home.

calls.title: Where a cards essay's YouTube link is saved
options: On its episode page, with the essay's own page pointing there
A second link field on the essay's own page too
Renders opens the episode page instead of the essay's own page
calls.why: One place to paste, the same as every other feed, and the essay's own page still plays from any home, which is why Renders keeps opening it.
calls.undo: Take cards essays out of the feeds that take a link and remove the essay page's link to its episode.
